# Merge

Combines the properties of several objects into one new object.

## Signature

```jyro
# fragment
Merge(values)
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `values` | array | An array of the objects to combine, in order. A null element is skipped; an element of any other type is a runtime error, found before anything is combined. Null is read as the empty array. |

## Returns

Object. A new object holding every property of every object in values. When more than one object has a property of the same name, the value of the last of them is kept. The objects in values are not changed. The empty object when values holds no object. Never null.

## Example

`Merge([{"a": 1, "b": 2}, {"b": 3}])` returns `{"a": 1, "b": 3}`.
